reuse.why: Introduces one getMonthWideCategories selection used by every month-wide action (copyPreviousMonth via an id set) and reuses the existing extractTagsFromText for the #fixed tag.

duplication.why: Removes the repeated category queries; the income-outside-tracking check is still repeated in each action rather than folded into the shared selection.

placement.why: The selection rule lives in budget/actions.ts beside the actions that use it, with a shared MonthWideActionArgs type; the new action is registered alongside the others.

scope.why: Edits are confined to month-wide actions, their registration, tests and release notes; dropping the unused hidden columns from getBudgetData follows from the change.

maintainability.why: Each new exclusion (templates, #fixed, hidden flag) landed in one function with a documented contract; the per-action income check is the remaining spot a maintainer must remember.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions, including copyPreviousMonth and the new setLastMonthSpending, take their category set from getMonthWideCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic introduced; the repeated income check is pre-existing and visible.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthWideCategories gains only includeHiddenCategories, the requested variation; no special-case branches or bypassing callers.
